final_answer:
# Allrecipes Dinners Section — 3 Recommended Recipes

I navigated to the Allrecipes Dinners section at https://www.allrecipes.com/recipes/17562/dinner/ and located the prominently featured "What's For Dinner?" recommendations. Here are 3 recommended dinner recipes:

| # | Recipe Title | URL |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **The 5 Best Easy Beef Taco Recipes We're Making on Repeat** (Featured) | https://www.allrecipes.com/best-easy-beef-taco-recipes-11802847 |
| 2 | **5 Easy Make-Ahead Dinner Recipes for Busy Weeks** | https://www.allrecipes.com/make-ahead-dinner-recipes-for-busy-weeks-11801928 |
| 3 | **20 Monday Night Dinner Recipes You'll Come Back to Again and Again** | https://www.allrecipes.com/monday-night-dinner-recipes-11785445 |

**Source:** Allrecipes "Dinner Recipes" page (https://www.allrecipes.com/recipes/17562/dinner/), captured in the "What's For Dinner?" recommendations block at the top of the section.

The "What's For Dinner?" feature on the Dinners landing page curates popular 5-star dinner recipe collections — these roundups are Allrecipes' top recommendations for the Dinners section. Additional recommended collections on the same page included "29 Seriously Delicious Chicken Breast Recipes" and "14 Casseroles You Didn't Know You Could Make in a Slow Cooker."
